flowRoot.flowPara: • Overcharging does set your passive bonuses back a bit, but it's often worth the temporary sacrifice for the large boost it gives.
• Biogen Mist is less effective than other Recoveries if it only hits you, but extremely powerful if you catch all of your allies in the burst.
• Arc Thrower can chain to your allies. It doesn't hurt them, but it can help you reach further away foes and it also counts toward increasing the damage.
• Flying (as with Repulsor Boost) is like shifting but also ignores normal difficult terrain and treats walls as difficult terrain (i.e. 2 squares of fly allows you to cross a wall).

• When Overcharging, you can use two total energy from any combination of mods. It's possible to be gaining the active effect from a mod by having energy on it while also Overcharging it with energy from the other two mods, effectively quadrupling the effect.

flowPara.flowSpan: • You can't Overcharge the same mod twice in the same turn (no sextupling!).

flowRoot.flowPara: • Rapid Reboot doesn't cause your Duration-based skills to tick down.
• When determing range for VEx Railgun, count your own square (i.e. a foe within melee range is 1 square away).
• Chain is an effect that causes an effect to "jump" to another foe within a specified range. Generally, as with Arc Thrower, it must target unique units with each jump.
